description: Use this when you need to estimate furnace manufacture age from a confirmed Lennox legacy, Rheem or Nordyne serial format or a maker-confirmed date. Calculates age at your selected as-of date, keeps NAHB and InterNACHI life guidance separate, applies EPA age guidance and the DOE repair comparison to your own quotes, and returns separately labeled historical and modeled replacement references. (API Tool Calls, by Cowerx)

as_of.description: Required real YYYY-MM-DD date for the age calculation.

brand.description: Lennox, Rheem or Nordyne; other brands require maker/dealer confirmation.

century.description: Maker/dealer-confirmed century; never inferred from age.

format_confirmed.description: True only after confirming this model/era uses the documented serial format.

manufacture_date.description: Optional maker-confirmed YYYY-MM-DD manufacture date; overrides serial decoding, not installation date.

model.description: Model from the rating plate; retained for identification.

repair_quote.description: Your own comparable repair quote in dollars; pair with replacement_quote.

replacement_quote.description: Your own comparable replacement quote in dollars; pair with repair_quote.

name: furnace_age
title: Furnace Age Calculator
